name: What design options are available for backyard ADUs?

mainEntity.name: What design options are available for backyard ADUs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backyard ADUs offer diverse design options to match your property and needs. Popular choices include studio units, one-bedroom, or two-bedroom layouts. You can opt for a modern aesthetic, traditional style, or something in between. Customization extends to exterior finishes, interior materials, and energy-efficient features. We work with clients to design ADUs that complement their existing home and fulfill their functional requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU design options range from studio to two-bedroom layouts, with various aesthetic styles, exterior finishes, and interior materials to choose from.
